headword: {小選挙区|しょうせんきょく}

definitions.explanation: An electoral district that sends one representative, the candidate with the most votes.

examples.japanese: {小選挙区|しょうせんきょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{当選|とうせん}→当選：07074_tousen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He won in a single-member district.

examples.japanese: {小選挙区|しょうせんきょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧しか⟦{当選|とうせん}→当選：07074_tousen⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Only one candidate wins in a single-member district.

examples.japanese: ⟦{衆議院|しゅうぎいん}→衆議院：14153_shuugiin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{小選挙区|しょうせんきょく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{比例代表|ひれいだいひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}み{合|あ}わせた→組み合わせる：04659_kumiawaseru⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: House of Representatives elections use a system that combines single-member districts with proportional representation.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小選挙区制|しょうせんきょくせい}: the single-member district system
- {小選挙区|しょうせんきょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{敗|やぶ}れる→敗れる：12712_yabureru⟧: to lose in one's district
- {比例復活|ひれいふっかつ}: winning a proportional seat after losing in a district

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Japan's lower house has combined the two since 1996: 289 seats come from single-member districts and 176 from proportional representation. Before that it used {中選挙区|ちゅうせんきょく}, districts with several members each.
